_comment: Starter supply-chain exposure catalog for the omarchy bumblebee plugin. Well-known public incidents only — add your own advisories as *.json files (same shape) under ~/.config/omarchy/plugins-data/bumblebee/catalog.d/ and they merge at scan time.

entries.name: chalk npm account-takeover release (Sep 2025 qix phish)
entries.source: GHSA-2v46-p5h4-248w / MAL-2025-46969 — maintainer phished 2025-09-08; chalk@5.6.1 shipped a crypto-clipping payload.

entries.name: debug npm account-takeover release (Sep 2025 qix phish)
entries.source: GHSA-4x49-vf9v-38px — debug@4.4.2 published 2025-09-08 with a browser crypto-stealer payload.

entries.name: event-stream flatmap-stream injection (2018)
entries.source: Malicious flatmap-stream dependency injected into event-stream@3.3.6 to harvest Copay bitcoin wallet keys.

entries.name: ua-parser-js hijacked releases (Oct 2021)
entries.source: Maintainer account takeover; malicious releases shipped cryptominers and credential stealers.

entries.name: rc hijacked releases (Nov 2021)

entries.name: node-ipc protestware payload (Mar 2022)
